titulo: The terminal starts by telling you where you are
lead: The terminal is just another window into the same folders you see in File Explorer. You type one line, and it returns another. With six commands, you can see where you are, what’s there, create your projects folder, and move between folders without a mouse.
objetivo: open cmd, see which folder you’re in, and move between folders with six commands, without a mouse.
hero_alt: Hands on a laptop keyboard with the black Command Prompt window open.

aprende.t: Open cmd and read the line that ends in >
See where you are with cd and what’s there with dir
See the same folder in File Explorer with explorer .

secoes.sub: You type, it responds, and > comes back, waiting for you.

nos.detalhe: When you open it, cmd shows a short line that ends in >, with the cursor blinking. The computer is waiting for you. Nothing happens until you type and press Enter.
Read the path like an address. Each backslash separates a folder, and the last one is where you are now. Your personal folder is C:\Users\ followed by your username.
The line without > is the computer’s response. Many commands that work don’t respond at all: the next command, such as cd or dir, confirms it worked.
The terminal and File Explorer show the same drive. Create a folder in one, and it appears in the other. The explorer . command opens the file window right in the folder you’re in.

secoes.volta: Command, response, and > back again: that’s the back-and-forth
secoes.legenda: On Mac and Linux, the terminal is called Terminal and ends in $; the commands have different names (see the table at the end of the lesson).

rolagem_fim.titulo: First your location, then the files
rolagem_fim.texto: Before any command that changes something, check the path before >. Many errors that look like AI failures are just caused by being in the wrong folder: if you don’t know where you are, the agent doesn’t either.

secoes.titulo: The six commands, one at a time
secoes.sub: Click each step. None of these deletes anything.

texto: Press the Windows key, type cmd, and press Enter. Command Prompt, the black window, opens. You don’t need to run it as an administrator.
If the line starts with PS, you opened PowerShell, another terminal. Close it and search for cmd again. On Mac: press Cmd+Space and type Terminal.
The cd command, typed with nothing else, is the map’s “you are here.” It shows the full path to the current folder.
On Mac and Linux, pwd does the same thing.
Once you know where you are, look at what’s inside. dir lists folders and files; dir /b shows only the names, one per line.
mkdir projetos creates the folder. cd projetos enters it, and the path before > changes.
Use short names without spaces or accents, like meu-primeiro-agente. Spaces and accents can be tricky in the terminal.
cd .. goes up one folder. explorer . opens File Explorer in the current folder: the dot means “here.”
cls clears the screen without deleting anything. The Tab key completes folder names as you type.

exemplo.texto: Lost? Type cd and read the output.

secoes.sub: Copy one block at a time into cmd. Replace whatever is between < > with your own text.

blocos.rot: cmd · where I am and what’s here
cmd · the projects folder and the first project folder
blocos.conteudo:
cd %USERPROFILE%
mkdir projetos
cd projetos
mkdir meu-primeiro-agente
cd meu-primeiro-agente
cd

blocos.rot: cmd · view the same folder and navigate
blocos.conteudo:
explorer .
cd ..
dir
cd meu-primeiro-agente
dir

blocos.rot: Mac and Linux · the same steps

abas.html:
C:\Users\ana> cd %USERPROFILE%
C:\Users\ana> mkdir projetos
C:\Users\ana> cd projetos
C:\Users\ana\projetos> mkdir meu-primeiro-agente
C:\Users\ana\projetos> cd meu-primeiro-agente
C:\Users\ana\projetos\meu-primeiro-agente> cd
C:\Users\ana\projetos\meu-primeiro-agente

mkdir and cd don’t show anything when they work. The path before > and running cd by itself confirm it.

• “The system cannot find the path specified”: the name is wrong or the folder doesn’t exist here. Run dir and copy the exact name.
  • “A subdirectory or file projetos already exists”: it’s already been created. Just enter it with cd projetos.
  • The line starts with PS: you’re in PowerShell. Close it and open cmd.

• cd by itself → pwd: where I am
  • dir → ls: lists the folder
  • mkdir name → mkdir -p name: creates a folder
  • cls → clear: clears the screen
  • type file → cat file: shows the file
  • %USERPROFILE% → ~: home folder

On Linux, uppercase and lowercase matter: Projetos and projetos are different folders.

secoes.sub: A pretend cmd: type the command for each mission and press Enter. Nothing runs on your computer.

missoes.pede: Find out which folder you’re in.
missoes.explica: Running cd by itself showed the address: Ana’s home folder. Nothing changed.

missoes.pede: Take a look at the names of what's here.
missoes.explica: dir /b lists only the names, one per line. dir without /b also shows the date and size.
Silence means success: mkdir doesn't respond when it works.
Look at the path before the >: it now includes \projetos. That's how you know you went in.
Short name, no spaces or accents: in the terminal, this avoids quotes and typos.
This is the folder where the agent will work in the next lessons.

missoes.pede: Open the same folder in File Explorer.
missoes.explica: The dot means "here." The terminal and File Explorer show the same place: create something in one, and it appears in the other.
cd .. goes up one level. To go in again: cd meu-primeiro-agente.

secoes.fim: Missions complete. Now do the same in your cmd: that's the practice right below.
secoes.legenda: Simulation: Ana's home folder is just an example. On your computer, you'll see your username.

secoes.sub: Do this on your computer. Move on only when the "done when" condition is true.

exercicios.titulo: E1 · First folder from the terminal
exercicios.texto: Create projetos\meu-primeiro-agente, go into it, and list the contents (it will be empty). Run explorer . and compare it with File Explorer.
exercicios.pronto: you can get to the folder using only the terminal, without the mouse, and say which folder you're in.

exercicios.titulo: E2 · Create it in one, see it in the other
exercicios.texto: In File Explorer, create any text file inside meu-primeiro-agente. Go back to cmd and run dir /b.
exercicios.pronto: the file you created with the mouse appears in the terminal list. If it doesn't, you're in another folder: run cd.

secoes.sub: Six commands, one AGENTS.md, and the first task, in less than two minutes.
The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: You opened cmd and want to know which folder you're in. What do you type?
perguntas.explica: Running cd by itself returns the full path of the current folder. dir shows what’s in it, but not the address.

perguntas.p: You ran mkdir projetos and the terminal didn’t respond. What does that mean?
opcoes: It failed and nothing was created.
You need to open it as an administrator.
perguntas.explica: Many commands stay silent when they work. The next command confirms it: dir shows the new folder.

perguntas.p: You created a file in File Explorer, but it doesn’t appear in dir. What’s the most likely cause?
opcoes: The terminal can’t see files from File Explorer.
You’re in a different folder in the terminal.
You need to restart the computer.
perguntas.explica: The terminal and File Explorer show the same drive. If the file doesn’t appear, the terminal is in a different folder: run cd and compare the paths.

perguntas.p: On the VPS, running Linux, which command does the same job as dir?
perguntas.explica: ls lists the folder. pwd is the equivalent of running cd by itself, and cat is the equivalent of type.
